ranking_method: Analyst due-diligence priority, not Golden Spot evidence score or investment ranking. Five verified venues selected from the 15 mapped candidates; incomplete citywide context prevents an automated ranking. No complete national competitor database is claimed.

storage_options.tradeoff: Extra handling and stock duplication; justified only if port delays, volume or flows require it.
Lease, staffing, equipment, systems, insurance and utilisation must be costed; a property listing is not an operating 3PL.

storage_options.advantage: May avoid a dedicated national DC at very small scale.

customs: Before shipment: confirm importer of record, HS code per SKU, origin evidence, invoice/packing list and transport documents. Revenue Service HS module determines duties, VAT, exemptions and documents. Declare and follow the assigned control channel; use bonded transit/storage only under the applicable procedure. EU dispatch does not itself establish preferential EU origin. No blanket duty rate or clearance duration is assumed.
raben_status: Preferred operator to consider for origin / Türkiye / partner solutions. Georgian own warehouse, last-mile network and rates are not confirmed; its current official country directory does not list Georgia. No messages or quotation requests sent.
